item.title: Seed Growth With Supplied Narration

exact_text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen explainer showing a seed sprouting. Use this exact voice-over: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Simple animation, no on-screen text or music.

item.tests: Tests whether a supplied script becomes verbatim audible narration synchronized with an explanatory visual sequence.

answer_sheet.Voice-over wording: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Simple animation showing the seed and its growth.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: English; voice choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Text and music: No on-screen text and no music.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
There is no on-screen text or music.

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen explainer showing a seed sprouting. Use this exact voice-over: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Simple animation, no on-screen text or music. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.**

The lowest-cost approach is **one LTX 2.5 generation at 480p**, with the animation and voice-over generated together.

| Option | Estimated cost | Trade-off |
|---|---:|---|
| **8 seconds, widescreen, with voice-over** | **192 credits** | Best fit for your request |
| 5 seconds, with voice-over | 120 credits | Your exact narration would sound rushed |
| 4 seconds, silent | 96 credits | Short visual demo, but omits your narration |

These use **24 credits per second**. LTX’s built-in audio adds no extra credits. **480p is the smallest supported resolution for this route**; making it silent wouldn’t reduce the per-second cost.

**Important:** built-in narration is cheaper, but the model may not reproduce every word exactly. A separate narration plan was quoted at **432 credits total**, and its proposed speech timing needs adjustment, so I wouldn’t recommend running that plan as-is.

My recommendation is the **8-second, 192-credit version**, subject to account eligibility and sufficient balance. I’ll wait for your approval before running it.

The planning checker also returned this confirmation question, although you already specified no on-screen text: “Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?” You can simply confirm **“192 credits approved; no on-screen text.”**

style.prompt: An 8-second widescreen educational explainer in simple clean 2D animation with flat colors. One continuous static shot of a seed in a cutaway view of brown soil, with a pale background and warm light above ground. 0–2 seconds: small water droplets enter the seed and it swells. 2–5 seconds: the seed opens and delicate roots visibly grow downward through the soil. 5–8 seconds: a green shoot grows upward out of the soil toward the light and opens its first tiny leaves. Clear readable botanical action, smooth time-lapse animation, consistent seed and composition. An off-camera calm clear narrator says this exact script once, beginning immediately and finishing within 8 seconds: "A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light." Voice-over only. No music, no sound effects. No on-screen text, labels, captions, titles, logos or watermarks.
